title: Kresna–Razlog uprising
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Kresna–Razlog uprising", at revision 1370626189, opens: "The Kresna–Razlog uprising, also known as the Kresna uprising, was an anti-Ottoman Bulgarian uprising that took place in Ottoman Macedonia, predominantly in the areas of modern Blagoevgrad Province in Bulgaria in late 1878 and early 1879. It was named by the insurgents as the Macedonian uprising." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3043924, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Bulgarian uprising against Ottoman rule". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
